title: Subject pair comparison
description: Derived per-pair ratios between subjects of one attempt, sealed as evidence alongside the run. Floats are allowed here because a comparison is evidence, never an identity: no identity document may contain a float, and crates/bench-schema's canonical_bytes refuses this one. Written by crates/benchctl over the sealed subject results; documentation mirror of the Comparison serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/classify.rs, which is the source of truth. Each ratio is OMITTED rather than null or zero when the underlying number was missing.

comparable.description: Whether the subjects were comparable at all. A single attempt of a diagnostic scenario is not, and says so. False leaves any ratios present but meaningless.

reasons.description: Why the subjects are not comparable; empty when comparable is true.

pairs.description: One entry per directed subject pair. Ratios are candidate over baseline, so a goodput ratio above one and a latency ratio below one both favour the candidate.

baseline.description: Subject name the ratios divide by.

candidate.description: Subject name the ratios are for.

acknowledged_goodput_ratio.description: Acknowledged records per second, candidate over baseline. Absent when either subject produced no result.

p99_latency_ratio.description: 99th percentile latency, candidate over baseline. Absent when either subject produced no result.
